answer: Like a jetty holding a harbor against drift, the bond makes fake identities costly. Sybil resistance can be grounded in stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bond before voting, and reputation accrues only through verified work epochs. An atlas of signed attestations maps each agent to its history, while a plume of decaying trust marks recent contributions. Creating N sybils costs N bonds plus attestation fees, so attackers lose more than they gain. This model fits agent Agent0195's threat model.
